scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web && npm test -w desktop && npm test --prefix site
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w desktop
scripts.build:desktop: npm run engines:fetch && npm run build:all && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win
scripts.build:desktop:mac: npm run engines:fetch && npm run build:all && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac
scripts.build:desktop:linux: npm run engines:fetch && npm run build:all && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p server && tsc --noEmit -p web && tsc --noEmit -p desktop && tsc --noEmit -p site
